item_description_text: A unicorn is a make-believe creature that can be compared to a horse with a long spiral horn on its forehead. Unicorns are often drawn with rainbow colored manes, white coats of fur and sometimes wings [similar to another make-believe creature called a pegasus]. In many stories, unicorns have magical powers and are fast and difficult to catch. Magical horses and similar animals were imagined in India where people carved unicorn-like images into clay 4000 years ago. Later, in Greece, images of unicorns changed into more like what we are familiar with today–inspired by writers like Ctesias who recorded second-hand stories of horses with horns and wings from India. Unicorns became part of common stories in Europe and even became the national animal of Scotland. Today, unicorns are popular in books, movies, shows, toys, clothes, art, and more.
